_comment: A realistic critique of Golem's current output for vis-03-plaza. Every requested object exists (prompt_fidelity 2) and the scene is still a block-out.

composition.justification: Top view shows benches, lamps and planters on an even 20-stud grid with no grouping or rhythm.

focal_point.justification: The fountain is present in hero but is the same 14-stud height as the lamp posts, so nothing dominates.

proportion_scale.justification: Bench seats sit around 2 studs and lamps around 14; walkable, but every part uses the same default thickness.

silhouette.justification: In the front view every object is an unbroken rectangle or cylinder; nothing is identifiable by outline.

material_coherence.justification: Every surface in all four views is Plastic, so stone, wood and metal are indistinguishable.

material_variety.justification: The materials histogram reports one material across all 41 parts.

palette_discipline.justification: Six BrickColors with no relationship: bright green planters beside a medium stone grey slab.

value_structure.justification: Hero view is a single mid-grey value; in greyscale nothing separates from the ground.

lighting_setup.justification: Lighting service untouched and no PointLights; the lamp heads are unlit yellow spheres.

atmosphere_mood.justification: Default sky, no atmosphere or fog, flat noon exposure in every view.

edge_trim_finish.justification: Every junction is a raw seam; no skirting, no border course, no caps on the lamp posts.

surface_detail_density.justification: The plaza floor is one 118-stud part; nothing in the scene is smaller than 2 studs.

prop_layering.justification: Architecture and a few major props only; no dressing layer anywhere in the eye view.

negative_space.justification: Props are spread evenly, leaving accidental gaps rather than shaped open space.

vertical_variation.justification: Ground plus one 14-stud tier; the front view is essentially two flat lines.

spatial_flow.justification: Walkable but unguided; no path, threshold or sightline suggests a direction in the top view.

ground_treatment.justification: Still the stock Studio baseplate, visible unmodified at the edges of the top view.

scene_cohesion.justification: Town-square theme stated only by the fountain; everything else is generic grey boxes.

prompt_fidelity.justification: Everything asked for exists and is recognisable: a square, a centrepiece, seating and planting.

technical_hygiene.justification: All 41 parts anchored and grouped, no visible z-fighting or intersections in any view.

defects.detail: stock baseplate visible past the edge of the plaza slab
flat noon exposure, no local lights
no border course where slab meets baseplate
lamp heads emissive but no PointLight

summary: A flat grey slab with a grid of grey boxes on it, containing everything the user asked for. The single biggest problem is that nothing has been given a material, a colour relationship or a light.
